_comment: CONTRACT: every route the API may answer with 2xx to an UNAUTHENTICATED caller.
probe.py (check `auth_surface`) calls every path+method in the live openapi.json
without Authorization; a 2xx on any route NOT listed here fails the run. This is
the test that would have caught S-15 (/auth/agent-key) on day one.
Keys are `METHOD <openapi path template>`. Each entry cites docs/api.md (or the
route's own docstring) as the reason it is public BY DESIGN — do not add a route
here to make the probe green; add it because the docs say it is public.
`must_not_exist` = routes that were deleted as security fixes; they must be absent
from openapi.json AND answer 404/405 live (regression net for deleted surface).

public.POST /api/v1/auth/token: password sign-in; docs/api.md Auth table (credentials in body)
public.POST /api/v1/auth/magic-link: legacy sign-in link; docs/api.md Auth table
public.POST /api/v1/auth/email-code: sends 6-digit code, 60s cooldown; docs/api.md Auth table
public.POST /api/v1/auth/verify-code: code -> JWT, creates user if new; docs/api.md Auth table
public.GET /api/v1/businesses/{business_id}/blo: optional bearer: anonymous callers get is_public blocks only (S-8, api PR #10)
public.POST /api/v1/businesses/{business_id}/op: one-click unauthenticated opt-out gated by ?token=; docs/api.md (GTM Phase 2 guardrail)
public.POST /api/v1/media/device-upload: Pi CAM upload, auth is X-Device-Api-Key header not Bearer; docs/api.md routes/media.py
public.GET /api/v1/media/local/{file_id}/{filen: serves stored media, path contained to UPLOAD_DIR (S-1); docs/api.md
public.GET /api/v1/media/{media_id}/verify: public C2PA/OTS status for a media id; routes/media.py::verify_media
public.POST /api/v1/devices/register: Pi CAM pairing, gated by the QR registration token in the body; routes/media.py::register_device
public.GET /api/v1/search: keyword+level search over published entities; docs/api.md
public.POST /api/v1/resolve-intent: TWIRA-ranked intent routing, MCP flagship; docs/api.md
public.POST /v1/tag-ping: anonymous tag.js beacon, always 204, 240/min/IP; docs/api.md Universal Tag + security.md B5

pending_owner_decision._comment: Live 2xx-to-anonymous surface that the docs do not sanction. Surfaced by dedicated probe checks (not by auth_surface, which uses dummy ids and so only catches endpoints that 2xx with junk input, the way /auth/agent-key did). Resolve each by fixing the route (then remove the entry) or by adding it to `public` with a docs/api.md citation.
pending_owner_decision.private_entity_read: GET /businesses/{id}, /businesses/{id}/preview and /businesses/{id}/proof all return a is_public=false / is_published=false entity's name+description to an anonymous caller who knows the UUID (confirmed 2026-09-14 against the 15.3 fixture e5b79aaa). Only private BLOCKS were ever scoped (S-8, api PR #10); the entity row itself and the agent preview/proof were not. docs/api.md marks by-slug/{slug}/public as 'published+public only' but says businesses CRUD is owner-checked. Owner decision: filter these three on is_public for non-owners, or document 'any entity readable by UUID' as intended for agents. Probe check `private_entity_exposure` asserts this.

must_not_exist.POST /api/v1/auth/agent-key: S-15: unauthenticated account+pk_live_ mint, deleted in api PR #23 (2026-09-11)
must_not_exist.POST /api/v1/auth/register: unverified account creation, deleted 2026-07-06 (known-issues '/auth/register is public')
